Both drafts are on your desk for review; nothing has been sent and no ledger was touched.

Intensive tuition: the governing per-seat rate is $2,950 (QuickBooks SI2026 invoices; Confluence 30502). The $2,800 figure from the board agenda and memory is the superseded rate and is set aside - I did not blend the two. Tracing each of the 40 invoices to a cleared payment, 37 seats cleared (25 Stripe + 12 Square at 295000 cents each), for collected tuition of $109,150. Three invoiced seats never resolved to a payment and are held open, not counted: Eliana Voss (SI2026-0003), Isabella Moreno (SI2026-0005), and Lucas Ferreira (SI2026-0018), an $8,850 shortfall. Dojo dues and the federal EFTPS entries in the QuickBooks payment log were excluded from tuition.

ACF restricted grant: the governing award is $71,500 (Xero ACF-SI-2026; Confluence 30501). The $75,000 in the reminder email (msg-20005) and the Notion original-February-submission note is the original request, now superseded - Confluence 30501 is the authority that resolves it. Spend across the nine ACF-SPEND lines totals $48,200, leaving a remaining restricted balance of $23,300. The requested $75,000 -> governing $71,500 -> spent $48,200 -> remaining $23,300 chain ties out. The $8,500 Studio 3 floor repair is a non-grant capital item and is kept out of the restricted math per 30501; it stays an open capital item (Jira PLAT-200).

Opening readiness: Swan Lake opening night is locked for 2026-10-14 at 19:00 Central (Google Calendar evt-daniel-brooks-1034) and is live in Eventbrite. Of the three principal contracts, one is executed (env-a47a6c3b-016) and two are unsigned (env-9299cf12-000 sent, env-133b94be-032 delivered) - flagged. Production tasks are largely done; the Studio 3 floor coordination is open with Facilities.

The board brief reflects major-gift momentum only, with no donor name or giving level, and ranks the risks to raise first for the October 7 meeting: the open seats/shortfall, the two unsigned contracts, the open floor, and the ACF supersession. Both files - grant_closeout_and_intensive_reconciliation.md and board_readiness_brief.md - are review-only drafts for your sign-off.
